slices.what: The five bridges N4 left open (`Uptime`, `SysInfo`, `VmProc`, `PipeGlue`, `PipeFiles`) become the kernel's own code
The buffer cache and a typed `Buf`: `vfs_bio`, `vfs_biomem`, `kern_bufq`, `kern_physio`
The vnode, the mount and the VFS core (`vfs_subr`, `vfs_sync`, `vfs_init`, `vfs_vops`, `vfs_default`, `spec_vnops`, deadfs); the vnode and mount operations as the Rust traits `Vnops` and `Vfs`
The VFS system calls (`vfs_syscalls`): 65 more entries handled natively
`ufs`, the layer the UFS family shares (16 files)
Close: `just check`, `just ci`, `just ci-full` and the comparison with a real OpenBSD green; the tag `n5-vfs`
